entries.subject: Donaldson thesis physical extents and nominal pole
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Table 4.3, Model 1; section 4.3.1.1; Table 4.5 supplies axis ratios a/b=1.06 and b/c=1.3. A smooth ellipsoid uses these proportions; no original convex mesh or local terrain is claimed.

entries.subject: SEPPCoN thermal radius as the display scale
entries.finding: The adopted thermal radius is 4.04 km. Using it as a volume-equivalent display radius is an explicit scaling convention; it does not measure a volume or absolute axis lengths.

entries.subject: Model 2
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Equally valid mirror solution; documented rather than presented as a separate observed surface.
entries.revisitWhen: New observations distinguish this alternative, or a comparison consistently uses its own axis definition and scale.

entries.subject: 137P conflicting equatorial pole table
entries.finding: Thesis Table 5.2 prints RA 188 degrees for Model 1, inconsistent with its ecliptic pole in section 4.3.1.1, Figure 4.29 and Tables 4.3/4.5. This package converts the repeatedly reported ecliptic pole (132.5, -56.5) directly, yielding RA 117.873 and Dec -37.100 degrees.
entries.revisitWhen: An erratum or author clarification resolves the inconsistent equatorial and ecliptic coordinates.
